## **Step 5: Computational and Decidability Barriers to Determining the Capacity of the 7-Cycle**

Four structural pathologies of Shannon capacity explain why a symmetric 7-vertex graph has resisted 70 years of investigation.  
First, **finite strong powers can be arbitrarily deceptive**. Noga Alon and Eyal Lubetzky (2006) proved that the normalized independence series ![][image316] can remain tiny (at most ![][image317]) for every power ![][image318] and then abruptly jump at an arbitrarily chosen high power ![][image319], and can in fact exhibit any prescribed finite sequence of jumps at powers ![][image320]59. Consequently, no fixed prefix ![][image321] approximates ![][image66] within a subpolynomial factor of ![][image322]59. While computing ![][image323] is NP-hard, deciding whether ![][image324] is **not even known to be decidable** (let alone in PSPACE or NP), and a restricted one-shot entanglement-assisted variant for classical-quantum channels was shown RE-hard (uncomputable) in a January 2026 preprint (arXiv:2601.22471)59.  
Second, **Shannon capacity breaks both natural semiring laws**. Haemers (1979) disproved Shannon's multiplicativity conjecture using the 27-vertex strongly regular graph ![][image325] and its complement ![][image326]: since ![][image327] and ![][image328], one gets ![][image329]2. Alon (1998) disproved Shannon's additivity conjecture for disjoint unions, constructing graphs with ![][image330] whose union satisfies ![][image331]2, and Strassen duality shows additivity and multiplicativity succeed or fail together2.  
Third, **exact capacity need not be attained at any finite power**. Guo and Watanabe (1990) established the first unattainability criteria, Alon and Lubetzky (2006) highlighted the elementary example ![][image332] whose capacity ![][image333] cannot equal ![][image334] for integers ![][image335]2, and Lavi and Sason (2026) constructed an infinite family of connected graphs whose Shannon capacities are unattainable at any finite power25. By the irreducible cubic ![][image336] derived in Step 2, if ![][image171], then ![][image2] itself must be unattainable at every finite power6.  
Fourth, **exponential state-space growth defeats brute-force search**: ![][image10] has 343 vertices, ![][image204] has 16,807 vertices, and ![][image208] has 282,475,249 vertices. Four concrete near-term milestones anchor active research:

### **Iterative Proof-Engineering Walkthrough**

Translating textbook proofs of Shannon capacity and Lovász's bound into Lean 4 \+ Mathlib runs into five concrete type-checking and library bottlenecks. Resolving each one cleanly shapes the final proof architecture.

> 1. **Graph Power Indexing (Fin d → V vs. Right-Nested Products):** Mathlib provides SimpleGraph.boxProd, SimpleGraph.circulantGraph, SimpleGraph.cycleGraph, and SimpleGraph.indepNum, but lacks strong products and Shannon capacity67. Defining strongPow G d on Fin d → V clashes immediately with Mathlib's Kronecker-product PSD theorem Matrix.PosSemidef.kronecker, which acts on n × m rather than Fin (d \+ 1\) → V69, forcing pervasive Matrix.reindex coercions. Switching StrongPowV V to right-nested tuples (0 \=\> Unit, d \+ 1 \=\> V × StrongPowV V d) aligns strongPow G (d \+ 1\) \= G ⊠ strongPow G d definitionally with Matrix.kroneckerMap (· \* ·). Defining C7 := SimpleGraph.circulantGraph ({1} : Set (ZMod 7)) supplies automatic decidable adjacency while matching Mathlib's cycleGraph 7 via SimpleGraph.cycleGraph\_eq\_circulantGraph 671.  
> 2. **Conditionally Complete Lattice Obligations (BddAbove on sSup):** In Mathlib, both le\_csSup (lower bounds) and csSup\_le (upper bounds) require explicit BddAbove and Nonempty witnesses. Combining SimpleGraph.exists\_isNIndepSet\_indepNum70 with Finset.card\_le\_univ gives (strongPow G d).indepNum ≤ (Fintype.card V) ^ d, bounding every root by Fintype.card V. Additionally, Mathlib's Mathlib.Analysis.Subadditive supplies Fekete's lemma as Submultiplicative.tendsto\_lim76, so applying it to the submultiplicative reciprocal sequence ![][image343] equates the supremum to ![][image344] when desired76.  
> 3. **Bypassing SDP Duality and Spectral Theory via a Rank-4 Sum-of-Squares Certificate:** Proving ![][image345] via SDP strong duality or Hermitian eigenvalues (Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues) requires heavy spectral machinery6. Packaging a **dual Lovász PSD certificate** LovaszCert G β as a symmetric matrix ![][image346] with ![][image347], ![][image348] on non-edges, and ![][image349] (![][image350]) eliminates spectral theory completely: for ![][image113] and ![][image351], the matrix ![][image352] decomposes explicitly into four nonnegative rank-1 cosine/sine outer products6. Passing this sum-of-squares expansion to Matrix.PosSemidef.of\_dotProduct\_mulVec\_nonneg74 closes PSD verification by positivity, while the entrywise trigonometric identity follows from a four-line telescoping proof of ![][image353]6.  
> 4. **Bridging Finsupp vs. Finset and Kronecker Closure:** Mathlib's base Matrix.PosSemidef quantifies over finitely supported vectors x : n →₀ R74, which complicates finite sums. Using Mathlib's finite-type bridge theorems Matrix.PosSemidef.of\_dotProduct\_mulVec\_nonneg and Matrix.PosSemidef.dotProduct\_mulVec\_nonneg74 keeps every quadratic form in plain x : V → ℝ and dotProduct (⬝ᵥ). For Kronecker closure LovaszCert.prod, writing ![][image354] gives the exact algebraic identity ![][image355], closed directly by Matrix.PosSemidef.kronecker, .smul, and .add69.  
> 5. **Decidability and Kernel decide vs. native\_decide:** Providing DecidableRel (strongPow C7 d).Adj lets Lean synthesize Decidable ((strongPow C7 d).IsIndepSet ↑S) via Mathlib's instDecidableIsIndepSetCoeFinsetOfDecidableEqOfDecidableRelAdj70. For the 33-word code in ![][image10] (528 pair checks6), kernel-checked decide keeps the trusted computing base minimal. At the scale of the 367-word base tuple (67,161 pair checks) and 257-digit layered certificates in ![][image6], pure kernel reduction becomes a bottleneck, which is why spectra-research/shannon-capacity-lean adopts native\_decide (compiled native evaluation, adding the Lean compiler to the trusted base)9.

Lean  
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Circulant  
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Clique  
import Mathlib.Analysis.Matrix.Order  
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real  
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic  
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic  
import Mathlib.Tactic

open scoped BigOperators Matrix Kronecker

namespace ShannonC7

/-\! \#\# 1\. Strong Products, Strong Powers, C₇, and Shannon Capacity \-/

/-- The strong product \`G ⊠ H\` on \`V × W\`. \-/  
def strongProd {V W : Type} (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W) :  
    SimpleGraph (V × W) where  
  Adj x y := x ≠ y ∧ (x.1 \= y.1 ∨ G.Adj x.1 y.1) ∧ (x.2 \= y.2 ∨ H.Adj x.2 y.2)  
  symm := by  
    rintro ⟨u₁, v₁⟩ ⟨u₂, v₂⟩ ⟨hne, h1, h2⟩  
    exact ⟨hne.symm, h1.imp Eq.symm G.symm, h2.imp Eq.symm H.symm⟩  
  loopless := by  
    rintro ⟨u, v⟩ ⟨hne, \_, \_⟩  
    exact hne rfl

infixl:70 " ⊠ " \=\> strongProd

instance instDecidableRelStrongProd {V W : Type} \[DecidableEq V\] \[DecidableEq W\]  
    (G : SimpleGraph V) (H : SimpleGraph W)  
    \[DecidableRel G.Adj\] \[DecidableRel H.Adj\] :  
    DecidableRel (G ⊠ H).Adj :=  
  fun x y \=\> inferInstanceAs (Decidable (x ≠ y ∧ (x.1 \= y.1 ∨ G.Adj x.1 y.1) ∧  
    (x.2 \= y.2 ∨ H.Adj x.2 y.2)))

/-- Right-nested vertex type for the \`d\`-fold strong power, matching \`Matrix.kroneckerMap\`. \-/  
def StrongPowV (V : Type) : ℕ → Type  
  \| 0 \=\> Unit  
  \| d \+ 1 \=\> V × StrongPowV V d

instance instFintypeStrongPowV {V : Type} \[Fintype V\] :  
    ∀ d, Fintype (StrongPowV V d)  
  \| 0 \=\> inferInstanceAs (Fintype Unit)  
  \| d \+ 1 \=\> @instFintypeProd V (StrongPowV V d) \_ (instFintypeStrongPowV d)

instance instDecidableEqStrongPowV {V : Type} \[DecidableEq V\] :  
    ∀ d, DecidableEq (StrongPowV V d)  
  \| 0 \=\> inferInstanceAs (DecidableEq Unit)  
  \| d \+ 1 \=\> @instDecidableEqProd V (StrongPowV V d) \_ (instDecidableEqStrongPowV d)

/-- The \`d\`-fold strong power \`G^⊠d\`. At \`d \= 0\`, the single-vertex edgeless graph \`⊥\`. \-/  
def strongPow {V : Type} (G : SimpleGraph V) : (d : ℕ) → SimpleGraph (StrongPowV V d)  
  \| 0 \=\> ⊥  
  \| d \+ 1 \=\> G ⊠ strongPow G d

instance instDecidableRelStrongPow {V : Type} \[DecidableEq V\]  
    (G : SimpleGraph V) \[DecidableRel G.Adj\] :  
    ∀ d, DecidableRel (strongPow G d).Adj  
  \| 0 \=\> fun \_ \_ \=\> isFalse id  
  \| d \+ 1 \=\> @instDecidableRelStrongProd V (StrongPowV V d) \_ (instDecidableEqStrongPowV d)  
      G (strongPow G d) \_ (instDecidableRelStrongPow G d)

lemma card\_strongPowV {V : Type} \[Fintype V\] (d : ℕ) :  
    Fintype.card (StrongPowV V d) \= (Fintype.card V) ^ d := by  
  induction d with  
  \| zero \=\> simp \[StrongPowV\]  
  \| succ d ih \=\>  
    change Fintype.card (V × StrongPowV V d) \= \_  
    rw \[Fintype.card\_prod, ih, pow\_succ'\]

/-- The 7-cycle \`C₇\` realized as the circulant graph on \`ZMod 7\` with jump \`{1}\`. \-/  
def C7 : SimpleGraph (ZMod 7\) :=  
  SimpleGraph.circulantGraph ({1} : Set (ZMod 7))

instance : DecidableRel C7.Adj := by  
  unfold C7  
  infer\_instance

/-- The set of \`d\`-th roots of independence numbers defining Shannon capacity. \-/  
def shannonSet {V : Type} (G : SimpleGraph V) : Set ℝ :=  
  {x : ℝ \| ∃ d : ℕ, 0 \< d ∧ x \= ((strongPow G d).indepNum : ℝ) ^ (1 / (d : ℝ))}

/-- The Shannon capacity \`Θ(G) \= sup\_{d ≥ 1} α(G^⊠d)^(1/d)\`. \-/  
noncomputable def shannonCapacity {V : Type} (G : SimpleGraph V) : ℝ :=  
  sSup (shannonSet G)

lemma indepNum\_le\_card {V : Type} \[Fintype V\] (G : SimpleGraph V) :  
    G.indepNum ≤ Fintype.card V := by  
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := G.exists\_isNIndepSet\_indepNum  
  rw \[← hs.card\_eq\]  
  exact Finset.card\_le\_univ s

lemma shannonSet\_nonempty {V : Type} (G : SimpleGraph V) : (shannonSet G).Nonempty :=  
  ⟨((strongPow G 1).indepNum : ℝ) ^ (1 / (1 : ℝ)), 1, Nat.one\_pos, rfl⟩

lemma shannonSet\_bddAbove {V : Type} \[Fintype V\] (G : SimpleGraph V) :  
    BddAbove (shannonSet G) := by  
  refine ⟨(Fintype.card V : ℝ), ?\_⟩  
  rintro x ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩  
  have hd\_pos : (0 : ℝ) \< (d : ℝ) := Nat.cast\_pos.mpr hd  
  have hle : ((strongPow G d).indepNum : ℝ) ≤ (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ d := by  
    have hnat : (strongPow G d).indepNum ≤ (Fintype.card V) ^ d := by  
      simpa \[card\_strongPowV\] using indepNum\_le\_card (strongPow G d)  
    exact\_mod\_cast hnat  
  calc  
    ((strongPow G d).indepNum : ℝ) ^ (1 / (d : ℝ))  
      ≤ ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ d) ^ (1 / (d : ℝ)) :=  
        Real.rpow\_le\_rpow (Nat.cast\_nonneg \_) hle (by positivity)  
    \_ \= ((Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ (d : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (d : ℝ)) := by  
        rw \[Real.rpow\_natCast\]  
    \_ \= (Fintype.card V : ℝ) ^ ((d : ℝ) \* (1 / (d : ℝ))) := by  
        rw \[← Real.rpow\_mul (Nat.cast\_nonneg \_)\]  
    \_ \= (Fintype.card V : ℝ) := by  
        rw \[mul\_one\_div\_cancel hd\_pos.ne', Real.rpow\_one\]

/-- Any explicit independent set \`s\` in \`G^⊠d\` certifies \`\|s\|^(1/d) ≤ Θ(G)\`. \-/  
theorem le\_shannonCapacity\_of\_indepSet {V : Type} \[Fintype V\] (G : SimpleGraph V)  
    {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 \< d) {s : Finset (StrongPowV V d)}  
    (hs : (strongPow G d).IsIndepSet (s : Set (StrongPowV V d))) :  
    (s.card : ℝ) ^ (1 / (d : ℝ)) ≤ shannonCapacity G := by  
  have hcard : (s.card : ℝ) ≤ ((strongPow G d).indepNum : ℝ) := by  
    exact\_mod\_cast hs.card\_le\_indepNum  
  have hroot : (s.card : ℝ) ^ (1 / (d : ℝ)) ≤  
      ((strongPow G d).indepNum : ℝ) ^ (1 / (d : ℝ)) :=  
    Real.rpow\_le\_rpow (Nat.cast\_nonneg \_) hcard (by positivity)  
  exact hroot.trans (le\_csSup (shannonSet\_bddAbove G) ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩)

/-- Uniform upper bounds \`α(G^⊠d) ≤ B^d\` imply \`Θ(G) ≤ B\`. \-/  
theorem shannonCapacity\_le {V : Type} \[Fintype V\] (G : SimpleGraph V) {B : ℝ}  
    (hB : 0 ≤ B) (h : ∀ d : ℕ, 0 \< d → ((strongPow G d).indepNum : ℝ) ≤ B ^ d) :  
    shannonCapacity G ≤ B := by  
  apply csSup\_le (shannonSet\_nonempty G)  
  rintro x ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩  
  have hd\_pos : (0 : ℝ) \< (d : ℝ) := Nat.cast\_pos.mpr hd  
  calc  
    ((strongPow G d).indepNum : ℝ) ^ (1 / (d : ℝ))  
      ≤ (B ^ d) ^ (1 / (d : ℝ)) :=  
        Real.rpow\_le\_rpow (Nat.cast\_nonneg \_) (h d hd) (by positivity)  
    \_ \= (B ^ (d : ℝ)) ^ (1 / (d : ℝ)) := by rw \[Real.rpow\_natCast\]  
    \_ \= B ^ ((d : ℝ) \* (1 / (d : ℝ))) := by rw \[← Real.rpow\_mul hB\]  
    \_ \= B := by rw \[mul\_one\_div\_cancel hd\_pos.ne', Real.rpow\_one\]

/-\! \#\# 2\. Dual Lovász PSD Certificate Engine (Kronecker-Multiplicative) \-/

/-- All-ones matrix \`J\` on \`V\`. \-/  
def allOnes (V : Type) : Matrix V V ℝ := Matrix.of (fun \_ \_ \=\> (1 : ℝ))

lemma sum\_rank1 {V : Type} \[Fintype V\] (x f : V → ℝ) :  
    ∑ i : V, x i \* (∑ j : V, (f i \* f j) \* x j) \= (∑ i : V, x i \* f i) ^ 2 := by  
  rw \[sq, Finset.sum\_mul\]  
  refine Finset.sum\_congr rfl fun i \_ \=\> ?\_  
  rw \[Finset.mul\_sum, Finset.mul\_sum\]  
  refine Finset.sum\_congr rfl fun j \_ \=\> ?\_  
  ring

lemma allOnes\_posSemidef (V : Type) \[Fintype V\] : (allOnes V).PosSemidef := by  
  refine Matrix.PosSemidef.of\_dotProduct\_mulVec\_nonneg ?\_ ?\_  
  · ext i j; simp \[allOnes, Matrix.conjTranspose\]  
  · intro x  
    have hq : star x ⬝ᵥ (allOnes V).mulVec x \= (∑ i : V, x i) ^ 2 := by  
      simpa \[star\_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, allOnes\] using  
        sum\_rank1 x (fun \_ \=\> (1 : ℝ))  
    rw \[hq\]; positivity

/-- A dual Lovász PSD certificate for \`G\` with inverse-capacity parameter \`β \> 0\`:  
    \`W\_{i,i} \= 1\`, \`W\_{i,j} \= 0\` on non-edges, and \`W \- β J ⪰ 0\`. \-/  
structure LovaszCert {V : Type} \[Fintype V\] (G : SimpleGraph V) (β : ℝ) where  
  W : Matrix V V ℝ  
  hβ : 0 \< β  
  diag\_one : ∀ i, W i i \= 1  
  nonadj\_zero : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → ¬ G.Adj i j → W i j \= 0  
  psd : (W \- β • allOnes V).PosSemidef

lemma LovaszCert.card\_le {V : Type} \[Fintype V\] \[DecidableEq V\]  
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {β : ℝ} (cert : LovaszCert G β)  
    {s : Finset V} (hs : G.IsIndepSet (s : Set V)) :  
    (s.card : ℝ) ≤ β⁻¹ := by  
  let x : V → ℝ := fun i \=\> if i ∈ s then 1 else 0  
  have hnn := cert.psd.dotProduct\_mulVec\_nonneg x  
  have hWx : x ⬝ᵥ cert.W.mulVec x \= (s.card : ℝ) := by  
    simp only \[dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, x\]  
    calc  
      ∑ i : V, (if i ∈ s then (1 : ℝ) else 0\) \*  
          (∑ j : V, cert.W i j \* (if j ∈ s then 1 else 0))  
        \= ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, cert.W i j := by  
          simp only \[mul\_ite, mul\_one, mul\_zero, ite\_mul, one\_mul, zero\_mul,  
            Finset.sum\_ite\_mem, Finset.univ\_inter\]  
      \_ \= ∑ i ∈ s, cert.W i i := by  
          refine Finset.sum\_congr rfl fun i hi \=\> ?\_  
          rw \[Finset.sum\_eq\_single i\]  
          · intro j hj hji  
            exact cert.nonadj\_zero i j hji.symm (hs hi hj hji.symm)  
          · intro hi'; exact absurd hi hi'  
      \_ \= (s.card : ℝ) := by simp \[cert.diag\_one\]  
  have hJx : x ⬝ᵥ (allOnes V).mulVec x \= (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2 := by  
    simp only \[dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, allOnes, Matrix.of\_apply, one\_mul, x\]  
    calc  
      ∑ i : V, (if i ∈ s then (1 : ℝ) else 0\) \* (∑ j : V, if j ∈ s then (1 : ℝ) else 0\)  
        \= (∑ i ∈ s, (1 : ℝ)) \* (∑ j ∈ s, (1 : ℝ)) := by  
          rw \[← Finset.sum\_mul\]; simp \[Finset.sum\_ite\_mem, Finset.univ\_inter\]  
      \_ \= (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2 := by simp \[sq\]  
  have hdiff : 0 ≤ (s.card : ℝ) \- β \* (s.card : ℝ) ^ 2 := by  
    have : star x ⬝ᵥ (cert.W \- β • allOnes V).mulVec x \=  
        x ⬝ᵥ cert.W.mulVec x \- β \* (x ⬝ᵥ (allOnes V).mulVec x) := by  
      simp \[star\_trivial, Matrix.sub\_mulVec, Matrix.smul\_mulVec,  
        dotProduct\_sub, dotProduct\_smul, smul\_eq\_mul\]  
    linarith \[hnn, this, hWx, hJx\]  
  by\_cases h0 : s.card \= 0  
  · rw \[h0, Nat.cast\_zero\]; exact inv\_nonneg.mpr cert.hβ.le  
  · have hpos : (0 : ℝ) \< (s.card : ℝ) := Nat.cast\_pos.mpr (Nat.pos\_of\_ne\_zero h0)  
    have hmul : β \* (s.card : ℝ) ≤ 1 := by nlinarith  
    calc  
      (s.card : ℝ) \= β⁻¹ \* (β \* (s.card : ℝ)) := by field\_simp \[cert.hβ.ne'\]  
      \_ ≤ β⁻¹ \* 1 := mul\_le\_mul\_of\_nonneg\_left hmul (inv\_nonneg.mpr cert.hβ.le)  
      \_ \= β⁻¹ := mul\_one \_

lemma LovaszCert.indepNum\_le {V : Type} \[Fintype V\] \[DecidableEq V\]  
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {β : ℝ} (cert : LovaszCert G β) :  
    (G.indepNum : ℝ) ≤ β⁻¹ := by  
  obtain ⟨s, hs⟩ := G.exists\_isNIndepSet\_indepNum  
  rw \[← hs.card\_eq\]  
  exact cert.card\_le hs.isIndepSet

/-- Base certificate on the 1-vertex edgeless graph \`⊥ : SimpleGraph Unit\`. \-/  
def LovaszCert.unit : LovaszCert (⊥ : SimpleGraph Unit) 1 where  
  W := allOnes Unit  
  hβ := zero\_lt\_one  
  diag\_one \_ := rfl  
  nonadj\_zero i j hne \_ := absurd (Subsingleton.elim i j) hne  
  psd := by  
    have : allOnes Unit \- (1 : ℝ) • allOnes Unit \= 0 := by simp  
    rw \[this\]; exact Matrix.PosSemidef.zero

/-- Kronecker closure: certificates multiply across strong products. \-/  
def LovaszCert.prod {V W : Type} \[Fintype V\] \[Fintype W\]  
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {H : SimpleGraph W} {β₁ β₂ : ℝ}  
    (c₁ : LovaszCert G β₁) (c₂ : LovaszCert H β₂) :  
    LovaszCert (G ⊠ H) (β₁ \* β₂) where  
  W := Matrix.kroneckerMap (· \* ·) c₁.W c₂.W  
  hβ := mul\_pos c₁.hβ c₂.hβ  
  diag\_one i := by simp \[Matrix.kroneckerMap, c₁.diag\_one, c₂.diag\_one\]  
  nonadj\_zero i j hne hnadj := by  
    simp only \[Matrix.kroneckerMap\]  
    change ¬ (i ≠ j ∧ (i.1 \= j.1 ∨ G.Adj i.1 j.1) ∧ (i.2 \= j.2 ∨ H.Adj i.2 j.2)) at hnadj  
    by\_cases h1 : i.1 \= j.1 ∨ G.Adj i.1 j.1  
    · have h2 : ¬ (i.2 \= j.2 ∨ H.Adj i.2 j.2) := fun h2 \=\> hnadj ⟨hne, h1, h2⟩  
      push\_neg at h2  
      rw \[c₂.nonadj\_zero i.2 j.2 h2.1 h2.2, mul\_zero\]  
    · push\_neg at h1  
      rw \[c₁.nonadj\_zero i.1 j.1 h1.1 h1.2, zero\_mul\]  
  psd := by  
    set M₁ := c₁.W \- β₁ • allOnes V  
    set M₂ := c₂.W \- β₂ • allOnes W  
    have hdecomp :  
        Matrix.kroneckerMap (· \* ·) c₁.W c₂.W \- (β₁ \* β₂) • allOnes (V × W) \=  
        Matrix.kroneckerMap (· \* ·) M₁ M₂ \+  
        β₂ • Matrix.kroneckerMap (· \* ·) M₁ (allOnes W) \+  
        β₁ • Matrix.kroneckerMap (· \* ·) (allOnes V) M₂ := by  
      ext ⟨u₁, v₁⟩ ⟨u₂, v₂⟩  
      simp only \[M₁, M₂, Matrix.sub\_apply, Matrix.add\_apply, Matrix.smul\_apply,  
        Matrix.kroneckerMap\_apply, allOnes, Matrix.of\_apply, smul\_eq\_mul\]  
      ring  
    rw \[hdecomp\]  
    have h1 := c₁.psd.kronecker c₂.psd  
    have h2 := (c₁.psd.kronecker (allOnes\_posSemidef W)).smul c₂.hβ.le  
    have h3 := ((allOnes\_posSemidef V).kronecker c₂.psd).smul c₁.hβ.le  
    exact (h1.add h2).add h3

/-- Inductive \`d\`-th power of a Lovász certificate. \-/  
def LovaszCert.pow {V : Type} \[Fintype V\] {G : SimpleGraph V} {β : ℝ}  
    (cert : LovaszCert G β) : (d : ℕ) → LovaszCert (strongPow G d) (β ^ d)  
  \| 0 \=\> by rw \[pow\_zero\]; exact LovaszCert.unit  
  \| d \+ 1 \=\> by  
      rw \[pow\_succ'\]  
      exact cert.prod (cert.pow d)

/-- Master upper bound theorem: a Lovász certificate \`(W, β)\` proves \`Θ(G) ≤ β⁻¹\`. \-/  
theorem shannonCapacity\_le\_of\_cert {V : Type} \[Fintype V\] \[DecidableEq V\]  
    {G : SimpleGraph V} {β : ℝ} (cert : LovaszCert G β) :  
    shannonCapacity G ≤ β⁻¹ := by  
  refine shannonCapacity\_le G (inv\_nonneg.mpr cert.hβ.le) fun d \_ \=\> ?\_  
  have h := (cert.pow d).indepNum\_le  
  rwa \[inv\_pow\] at h

/-\! \#\# 3\. Rank-4 Fourier Sum-of-Squares Certificate for \`ϑ(C₇)\` \-/

noncomputable def θ7 : ℝ := Real.pi / 7  
noncomputable def β7 : ℝ := (1 \+ Real.cos θ7) / (7 \* Real.cos θ7)  
noncomputable def lam1 : ℝ := 1 \+ Real.cos (2 \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7  
noncomputable def lam2 : ℝ := 1 \+ Real.cos (4 \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7

lemma cos\_θ7\_pos : 0 \< Real.cos θ7 := by  
  apply Real.cos\_pos\_of\_mem\_Ioo  
  unfold θ7; constructor \<;\> linarith \[Real.pi\_pos\]

lemma β7\_pos : 0 \< β7 := by  
  unfold β7; have := cos\_θ7\_pos; positivity

lemma lam1\_pos : 0 \< lam1 := by  
  unfold lam1  
  have h1 : 0 \< Real.cos (2 \* θ7) := by  
    apply Real.cos\_pos\_of\_mem\_Ioo  
    unfold θ7; constructor \<;\> linarith \[Real.pi\_pos\]  
  have h2 := cos\_θ7\_pos  
  positivity

lemma lam2\_pos : 0 \< lam2 := by  
  unfold lam2  
  have hc : 0 \< Real.cos θ7 := cos\_θ7\_pos  
  have hcos : Real.cos (4 \* θ7) \= \-Real.cos (3 \* θ7) := by  
    have h4 : 4 \* θ7 \= Real.pi \- 3 \* θ7 := by unfold θ7; ring  
    rw \[h4, Real.cos\_pi\_sub\]  
  have hlt : Real.cos (3 \* θ7) \< Real.cos θ7 := by  
    apply Real.strictAntiOn\_cos  
    · unfold θ7; constructor \<;\> linarith \[Real.pi\_pos\]  
    · unfold θ7; constructor \<;\> linarith \[Real.pi\_pos\]  
    · unfold θ7; linarith \[Real.pi\_pos\]  
  rw \[hcos\]  
  have hdiv : \-1 \< \-Real.cos (3 \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7 := by  
    rw \[lt\_div\_iff₀ hc\]; linarith  
  linarith

/-- Discrete Fourier orthogonality modulo 7 via elementary telescoping. \-/  
lemma sum\_cos\_seven (r : ℤ) :  
    (∑ m : Fin 7, Real.cos (2 \* (m : ℝ) \* (r : ℝ) \* θ7)) \=  
    if (7 : ℤ) ∣ r then 7 else 0 := by  
  split\_ifs with hdiv  
  · rcases hdiv with ⟨k, rfl⟩  
    have hterm : ∀ m : Fin 7, Real.cos (2 \* (m : ℝ) \* ((7 \* k : ℤ) : ℝ) \* θ7) \= 1 := by  
      intro m  
      have harg : 2 \* (m : ℝ) \* ((7 \* k : ℤ) : ℝ) \* θ7 \=  
          (((m.val : ℤ) \* k : ℤ) : ℝ) \* (2 \* Real.pi) := by  
        unfold θ7; push\_cast; ring  
      rw \[harg, Real.cos\_int\_mul\_two\_pi\]  
    simp \[hterm\]  
  · have hsin\_ne : 2 \* Real.sin ((r : ℝ) \* θ7) ≠ 0 := by  
      intro h0  
      have hs : Real.sin ((r : ℝ) \* θ7) \= 0 := by linarith  
      rw \[Real.sin\_eq\_zero\_iff\] at hs  
      rcases hs with ⟨k, hk⟩  
      have hkr : (r : ℝ) \= (7 \* k : ℤ) := by  
        unfold θ7 at hk  
        have hpi : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi\_pos.ne'  
        push\_cast; field\_simp at hk; linarith  
      have : r \= 7 \* k := by exact\_mod\_cast hkr  
      exact hdiv ⟨k, this⟩  
    apply mul\_left\_cancel₀ hsin\_ne  
    rw \[mul\_zero, Finset.mul\_sum\]  
    have htele : ∀ m : Fin 7,  
        2 \* Real.sin ((r : ℝ) \* θ7) \* Real.cos (2 \* (m : ℝ) \* (r : ℝ) \* θ7) \=  
        Real.sin ((2 \* (m : ℝ) \+ 1\) \* (r : ℝ) \* θ7) \-  
        Real.sin ((2 \* (m : ℝ) \- 1\) \* (r : ℝ) \* θ7) := by  
      intro m  
      have h1 := Real.sin\_add ((2 \* (m : ℝ)) \* (r : ℝ) \* θ7) ((r : ℝ) \* θ7)  
      have h2 := Real.sin\_sub ((2 \* (m : ℝ)) \* (r : ℝ) \* θ7) ((r : ℝ) \* θ7)  
      have harg1 : 2 \* (m : ℝ) \* (r : ℝ) \* θ7 \+ (r : ℝ) \* θ7 \=  
          (2 \* (m : ℝ) \+ 1\) \* (r : ℝ) \* θ7 := by ring  
      have harg2 : 2 \* (m : ℝ) \* (r : ℝ) \* θ7 \- (r : ℝ) \* θ7 \=  
          (2 \* (m : ℝ) \- 1\) \* (r : ℝ) \* θ7 := by ring  
      rw \[harg1\] at h1; rw \[harg2\] at h2  
      linarith  
    simp\_rw \[htele\]  
    rw \[Fin.sum\_univ\_seven\]  
    have hwrap : Real.sin (13 \* (r : ℝ) \* θ7) \= Real.sin (-((r : ℝ) \* θ7)) := by  
      have h13 : 13 \* (r : ℝ) \* θ7 \= \-((r : ℝ) \* θ7) \+ (r : ℤ) \* (2 \* Real.pi) := by  
        unfold θ7; ring  
      rw \[h13, Real.sin\_add\_int\_mul\_two\_pi\]  
    norm\_num  
    ring\_nf at hwrap ⊢  
    linarith \[hwrap\]

/-- Explicit scaled dual matrix \`W \= I \+ (1 / (2 cos(π/7))) A(C₇)\`. \-/  
noncomputable def W7 : Matrix (ZMod 7\) (ZMod 7\) ℝ :=  
  Matrix.of fun i j \=\>  
    if i \= j then 1  
    else if C7.Adj i j then 1 / (2 \* Real.cos θ7)  
    else 0

lemma W7\_sub\_β7\_entry (i j : ZMod 7\) :  
    (W7 \- β7 • allOnes (ZMod 7)) i j \=  
    (2 / 7\) \* lam1 \* (Real.cos (2 \* (i.val : ℝ) \* θ7) \* Real.cos (2 \* (j.val : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
                      Real.sin (2 \* (i.val : ℝ) \* θ7) \* Real.sin (2 \* (j.val : ℝ) \* θ7)) \+  
    (2 / 7\) \* lam2 \* (Real.cos (4 \* (i.val : ℝ) \* θ7) \* Real.cos (4 \* (j.val : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
                      Real.sin (4 \* (i.val : ℝ) \* θ7) \* Real.sin (4 \* (j.val : ℝ) \* θ7)) := by  
  set d : ℤ := (i.val : ℤ) \- (j.val : ℤ)  
  have hcos\_sub1 : Real.cos (2 \* (i.val : ℝ) \* θ7) \* Real.cos (2 \* (j.val : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
      Real.sin (2 \* (i.val : ℝ) \* θ7) \* Real.sin (2 \* (j.val : ℝ) \* θ7) \=  
      Real.cos (2 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) := by  
    rw \[← Real.cos\_sub\]; congr 1; simp \[d\]; ring  
  have hcos\_sub2 : Real.cos (4 \* (i.val : ℝ) \* θ7) \* Real.cos (4 \* (j.val : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
      Real.sin (4 \* (i.val : ℝ) \* θ7) \* Real.sin (4 \* (j.val : ℝ) \* θ7) \=  
      Real.cos (4 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) := by  
    rw \[← Real.cos\_sub\]; congr 1; simp \[d\]; ring  
  rw \[hcos\_sub1, hcos\_sub2\]  
  have hsum\_eval :  
      (∑ m : Fin 7, (1 \+ Real.cos (2 \* (m : ℝ) \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7) \*  
          Real.cos (2 \* (m : ℝ) \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7)) \=  
      (if (7 : ℤ) ∣ d then (7 : ℝ) else 0\) \+  
      (1 / (2 \* Real.cos θ7)) \*  
        ((if (7 : ℤ) ∣ (d \- 1\) then (7 : ℝ) else 0\) \+  
         (if (7 : ℤ) ∣ (d \+ 1\) then (7 : ℝ) else 0)) := by  
    have hsplit : ∀ m : Fin 7,  
        (1 \+ Real.cos (2 \* (m : ℝ) \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7) \*  
          Real.cos (2 \* (m : ℝ) \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \=  
        Real.cos (2 \* (m : ℝ) \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
        (1 / (2 \* Real.cos θ7)) \*  
          (Real.cos (2 \* (m : ℝ) \* ((d \- 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
           Real.cos (2 \* (m : ℝ) \* ((d \+ 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) \* θ7)) := by  
      intro m  
      have hprod := Real.two\_mul\_cos\_mul\_cos (2 \* (m : ℝ) \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) (2 \* (m : ℝ) \* θ7)  
      have hc := cos\_θ7\_pos.ne'  
      have ha1 : 2 \* (m : ℝ) \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7 \- 2 \* (m : ℝ) \* θ7 \=  
          2 \* (m : ℝ) \* ((d \- 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) \* θ7 := by push\_cast; ring  
      have ha2 : 2 \* (m : ℝ) \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7 \+ 2 \* (m : ℝ) \* θ7 \=  
          2 \* (m : ℝ) \* ((d \+ 1 : ℤ) : ℝ) \* θ7 := by push\_cast; ring  
      rw \[ha1, ha2\] at hprod  
      field\_simp \[hc\]; linarith  
    simp\_rw \[hsplit, Finset.sum\_add\_distrib, ← Finset.mul\_sum\]  
    rw \[sum\_cos\_seven d, sum\_cos\_seven (d \- 1), sum\_cos\_seven (d \+ 1)\]  
  have hsum\_modes :  
      (∑ m : Fin 7, (1 \+ Real.cos (2 \* (m : ℝ) \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7) \*  
          Real.cos (2 \* (m : ℝ) \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7)) \=  
      7 \* β7 \+ 2 \* lam1 \* Real.cos (2 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
               2 \* lam2 \* Real.cos (4 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) := by  
    have hc := cos\_θ7\_pos.ne'  
    have h6 : Real.cos (6 \* θ7) \= \-Real.cos θ7 := by  
      have : 6 \* θ7 \= Real.pi \- θ7 := by unfold θ7; ring  
      rw \[this, Real.cos\_pi\_sub\]  
    have h8 : Real.cos (8 \* θ7) \= \-Real.cos θ7 := by  
      have : 8 \* θ7 \= Real.pi \+ θ7 := by unfold θ7; ring  
      rw \[this, Real.cos\_pi\_add\]  
    have h10 : Real.cos (10 \* θ7) \= Real.cos (4 \* θ7) := by  
      have : 10 \* θ7 \= 2 \* Real.pi \- 4 \* θ7 := by unfold θ7; ring  
      rw \[this, Real.cos\_two\_pi\_sub\]  
    have h12 : Real.cos (12 \* θ7) \= Real.cos (2 \* θ7) := by  
      have : 12 \* θ7 \= 2 \* Real.pi \- 2 \* θ7 := by unfold θ7; ring  
      rw \[this, Real.cos\_two\_pi\_sub\]  
    have h10d : Real.cos (10 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \= Real.cos (4 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) := by  
      have : 10 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7 \= \-(4 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \+ (d : ℤ) \* (2 \* Real.pi) := by  
        unfold θ7; ring  
      rw \[this, Real.cos\_add\_int\_mul\_two\_pi, Real.cos\_neg\]  
    have h12d : Real.cos (12 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \= Real.cos (2 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) := by  
      have : 12 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7 \= \-(2 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \+ (d : ℤ) \* (2 \* Real.pi) := by  
        unfold θ7; ring  
      rw \[this, Real.cos\_add\_int\_mul\_two\_pi, Real.cos\_neg\]  
    rw \[Fin.sum\_univ\_seven\]  
    have hnorm :  
        (1 \+ Real.cos (2 \* ((0 : Fin 7\) : ℝ) \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7) \*  
          Real.cos (2 \* ((0 : Fin 7\) : ℝ) \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
        (1 \+ Real.cos (2 \* ((1 : Fin 7\) : ℝ) \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7) \*  
          Real.cos (2 \* ((1 : Fin 7\) : ℝ) \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
        (1 \+ Real.cos (2 \* ((2 : Fin 7\) : ℝ) \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7) \*  
          Real.cos (2 \* ((2 : Fin 7\) : ℝ) \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
        (1 \+ Real.cos (2 \* ((3 : Fin 7\) : ℝ) \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7) \*  
          Real.cos (2 \* ((3 : Fin 7\) : ℝ) \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
        (1 \+ Real.cos (2 \* ((4 : Fin 7\) : ℝ) \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7) \*  
          Real.cos (2 \* ((4 : Fin 7\) : ℝ) \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
        (1 \+ Real.cos (2 \* ((5 : Fin 7\) : ℝ) \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7) \*  
          Real.cos (2 \* ((5 : Fin 7\) : ℝ) \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
        (1 \+ Real.cos (2 \* ((6 : Fin 7\) : ℝ) \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7) \*  
          Real.cos (2 \* ((6 : Fin 7\) : ℝ) \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \=  
        (1 \+ Real.cos 0 / Real.cos θ7) \* Real.cos 0 \+  
        (1 \+ Real.cos (2 \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7) \* Real.cos (2 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
        (1 \+ Real.cos (4 \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7) \* Real.cos (4 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
        (1 \+ Real.cos (6 \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7) \* Real.cos (6 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
        (1 \+ Real.cos (8 \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7) \* Real.cos (8 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
        (1 \+ Real.cos (10 \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7) \* Real.cos (10 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) \+  
        (1 \+ Real.cos (12 \* θ7) / Real.cos θ7) \* Real.cos (12 \* (d : ℝ) \* θ7) := by  
      norm\_num; ring\_nf  
    rw \[hnorm, Real.cos\_zero, h6, h8, h10, h12, h10d, h12d\]  
    unfold β7 lam1 lam2  
    field\_simp \[hc\]  
    ring  
  have hW : W7 i j \=  
      ((if (7 : ℤ) ∣ d then (7 : ℝ) else 0\) \+  
       (1 / (2 \* Real.cos θ7)) \*  
         ((if (7 : ℤ) ∣ (d \- 1\) then (7 : ℝ) else 0\) \+  
          (if (7 : ℤ) ∣ (d \+ 1\) then (7 : ℝ) else 0))) / 7 := by  
    have h0 : (7 : ℤ) ∣ d ↔ i \= j := by  
      rw \[← ZMod.intCast\_zmod\_eq\_zero\_iff\_dvd\]  
      simp \[d, sub\_eq\_zero\]  
    have h1 : (7 : ℤ) ∣ (d \- 1\) ↔ i \- j \= 1 := by  
      rw \[← ZMod.intCast\_zmod\_eq\_zero\_iff\_dvd\]  
      simp \[d, sub\_eq\_zero\]  
    have hm1 : (7 : ℤ) ∣ (d \+ 1\) ↔ j \- i \= 1 := by  
      rw \[← ZMod.intCast\_zmod\_eq\_zero\_iff\_dvd\]  
      simp \[d\]; constructor \<;\> intro h \<;\> linear\_combination \-h  
    simp only \[W7, Matrix.of\_apply, C7, SimpleGraph.circulantGraph\_adj,  
      Set.mem\_singleton\_iff, h0, h1, hm1\]  
    by\_cases hij : i \= j  
    · subst hij  
      have hne1 : (0 : ZMod 7\) ≠ 1 := by decide  
      simp \[hne1\]  
    · by\_cases hsub1 : i \- j \= 1  
      · have hsub2 : j \- i ≠ 1 := by  
          intro h2  
          have : (2 : ZMod 7\) \= 0 := by linear\_combination \-(hsub1 \+ h2)  
          exact absurd this (by decide)  
        simp \[hij, hsub1, hsub2\]; ring  
      · by\_cases hsub2 : j \- i \= 1  
        · simp \[hij, hsub1, hsub2\]; ring  
        · simp \[hij, hsub1, hsub2\]  
  simp only \[Matrix.sub\_apply, Matrix.smul\_apply, allOnes, Matrix.of\_apply,  
    smul\_eq\_mul, mul\_one\]  
  linarith \[hsum\_eval, hsum\_modes, hW\]

/-- Explicit Lovász certificate for \`C₇\` with \`β₇ \= (1 \+ cos(π/7)) / (7 cos(π/7))\`. \-/  
noncomputable def c7LovaszCert : LovaszCert C7 β7 where  
  W := W7  
  hβ := β7\_pos  
  diag\_one i := by simp \[W7\]  
  nonadj\_zero i j hne hnadj := by simp \[W7, hne, hnadj\]  
  psd := by  
    refine Matrix.PosSemidef.of\_dotProduct\_mulVec\_nonneg ?\_ ?\_  
    · ext i j  
      simp only \[Matrix.conjTranspose\_apply, star\_trivial, Matrix.sub\_apply,  
        Matrix.smul\_apply, allOnes, Matrix.of\_apply, W7\]  
      by\_cases hij : i \= j  
      · subst hij; simp  
      · have hji : j ≠ i := Ne.symm hij  
        have hadj : C7.Adj j i ↔ C7.Adj i j := ⟨C7.symm, C7.symm⟩  
        simp \[hij, hji, hadj\]  
    · intro x  
      let c1 : ZMod 7 → ℝ := fun i \=\> Real.cos (2 \* (i.val : ℝ) \* θ7)  
      let s1 : ZMod 7 → ℝ := fun i \=\> Real.sin (2 \* (i.val : ℝ) \* θ7)  
      let c2 : ZMod 7 → ℝ := fun i \=\> Real.cos (4 \* (i.val : ℝ) \* θ7)  
      let s2 : ZMod 7 → ℝ := fun i \=\> Real.sin (4 \* (i.val : ℝ) \* θ7)  
      have hquad :  
          star x ⬝ᵥ (W7 \- β7 • allOnes (ZMod 7)).mulVec x \=  
          (2 / 7\) \* lam1 \* ((∑ i : ZMod 7, x i \* c1 i) ^ 2 \+  
                            (∑ i : ZMod 7, x i \* s1 i) ^ 2\) \+  
          (2 / 7\) \* lam2 \* ((∑ i : ZMod 7, x i \* c2 i) ^ 2 \+  
                            (∑ i : ZMod 7, x i \* s2 i) ^ 2\) := by  
        rw \[← sum\_rank1 x c1, ← sum\_rank1 x s1, ← sum\_rank1 x c2, ← sum\_rank1 x s2\]  
        simp only \[star\_trivial, dotProduct, Matrix.mulVec, W7\_sub\_β7\_entry,  
          c1, s1, c2, s2, mul\_add, Finset.mul\_sum, ← Finset.sum\_add\_distrib\]  
        refine Finset.sum\_congr rfl fun i \_ \=\> ?\_  
        simp only \[← Finset.sum\_add\_distrib\]  
        refine Finset.sum\_congr rfl fun j \_ \=\> ?\_  
        ring  
      rw \[hquad\]  
      have h1 := lam1\_pos.le  
      have h2 := lam2\_pos.le  
      positivity

/-- Lovász's 1979 Upper Bound: \`Θ(C₇) ≤ 7 cos(π/7) / (1 \+ cos(π/7))\`. \-/  
theorem shannonCapacity\_C7\_le\_lovasz :  
    shannonCapacity C7 ≤ (7 \* Real.cos (Real.pi / 7)) / (1 \+ Real.cos (Real.pi / 7)) := by  
  have h := shannonCapacity\_le\_of\_cert c7LovaszCert  
  have hinv : β7⁻¹ \= (7 \* Real.cos (Real.pi / 7)) / (1 \+ Real.cos (Real.pi / 7)) := by  
    unfold β7 θ7; rw \[inv\_div\]  
  rwa \[hinv\] at h

/-\! \#\# 4\. Explicit Certified Lower Bound in \`C₇⊠³\`: \`Θ(C₇) ≥ 33^(1/3)\` \-/

/-- Helper constructor embedding triples into \`StrongPowV (ZMod 7\) 3\`. \-/  
def mk3 (a b c : ZMod 7\) : StrongPowV (ZMod 7\) 3 := (a, (b, (c, ())))

/-- Verified maximum independent set of size \`33 \= α(C₇⊠³)\`. \-/  
def c7CubeList : List (StrongPowV (ZMod 7\) 3\) :=  
  \[ mk3 0 1 1, mk3 0 4 2, mk3 0 4 4, mk3 0 6 0, mk3 0 6 5,  
    mk3 1 1 4, mk3 1 1 6, mk3 1 3 0, mk3 1 6 3,  
    mk3 2 1 2, mk3 2 3 3, mk3 2 3 5, mk3 2 5 6, mk3 2 6 1,  
    mk3 3 0 4, mk3 3 0 6, mk3 3 2 0, mk3 3 4 1, mk3 3 5 4,  
    mk3 4 0 2, mk3 4 2 5, mk3 4 3 3, mk3 4 4 6,  
    mk3 5 0 5, mk3 5 1 0, mk3 5 3 1, mk3 5 5 2, mk3 5 5 4, mk3 5 6 0,  
    mk3 6 0 3, mk3 6 2 3, mk3 6 2 5, mk3 6 4 6 \]

def c7CubeFinset : Finset (StrongPowV (ZMod 7\) 3\) := c7CubeList.toFinset

lemma c7CubeFinset\_card : c7CubeFinset.card \= 33 := by decide

lemma c7CubeFinset\_isIndep :  
    (strongPow C7 3).IsIndepSet (c7CubeFinset : Set (StrongPowV (ZMod 7\) 3)) := by  
  decide

/-- Certified Lower Bound: \`33^(1/3) ≤ Θ(C₇)\` (≈ 3.207534). \-/  
theorem shannonCapacity\_C7\_ge\_cbrt33 :  
    (33 : ℝ) ^ (1 / (3 : ℝ)) ≤ shannonCapacity C7 := by  
  have h := le\_shannonCapacity\_of\_indepSet C7 (by decide : 0 \< 3\) c7CubeFinset\_isIndep  
  rwa \[c7CubeFinset\_card\] at h

/-- Combined Self-Contained Sandwich Theorem for \`Θ(C₇)\`. \-/  
theorem shannonCapacity\_C7\_sandwich :  
    (33 : ℝ) ^ (1 / (3 : ℝ)) ≤ shannonCapacity C7 ∧  
    shannonCapacity C7 ≤ (7 \* Real.cos (Real.pi / 7)) / (1 \+ Real.cos (Real.pi / 7)) :=  
  ⟨shannonCapacity\_C7\_ge\_cbrt33, shannonCapacity\_C7\_le\_lovasz⟩

/-\! \#\# 5\. Buys–Polak–Zuiddam (2026) Valid-Tuple Profile Algebra & Open Problem \-/

/-- Closed neighborhood of a vertex set \`S\` in \`G\`. \-/  
def closedNbr {V : Type} \[Fintype V\] \[DecidableEq V\]  
    (G : SimpleGraph V) \[DecidableRel G.Adj\] (S : Finset V) : Finset V :=  
  Finset.univ.filter fun v \=\> ∃ s ∈ S, v \= s ∨ G.Adj v s

/-- Valid tuple \`(I, S, f₀, f₁, X)\` of Buys–Polak–Zuiddam (arXiv:2607.29681) / Gao (2026). \-/  
structure ValidTuple {V : Type} \[Fintype V\] \[DecidableEq V\]  
    (G : SimpleGraph V) \[DecidableRel G.Adj\] where  
  I : Finset V  
  S : Finset V  
  f0 : V → V  
  f1 : V → V  
  X : Finset V  
  indep\_I : G.IsIndepSet (I : Set V)  
  sub\_S : S ⊆ I  
  toggle\_S : ∀ s ∈ S, (f0 s \= s ∧ f1 s ≠ s) ∨ (f0 s ≠ s ∧ f1 s \= s)  
  priv0 : ∀ s ∈ S, closedNbr G {f0 s} ∩ I \= {s}  
  priv1 : ∀ s ∈ S, closedNbr G {f1 s} ∩ I \= {s}  
  indep\_f0 : G.IsIndepSet ((S.image f0) : Set V)  
  indep\_f1 : G.IsIndepSet ((S.image f1) : Set V)  
  indep\_X : G.IsIndepSet (X : Set V)  
  disjoint\_nbr :  
    (X ∩ closedNbr G (S.image f0) ∩ closedNbr G (S.image f1)) \= ∅

/-- Four-integer profile \`Π(τ) \= (a, b, c, d)\` and product operation \`⋆\`. \-/  
structure Profile where  
  a : ℕ  
  b : ℕ  
  c : ℕ  
  d : ℕ  
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def Profile.star (p q : Profile) : Profile :=  
  { a := (p.a \- p.b) \* (q.a \- q.b) \+ p.c \* q.b \+ p.b \* q.c  
    b := p.d \* q.b \+ p.b \* q.d  
    c := p.c \* q.c  
    d := p.d \* q.d \+ (p.c \- p.d) \* (q.c \- q.d) }

/-- Exact arithmetic checks: Gao's base profile \`(367, 8, 367, 321)\` squares to \`134,753\`  
    in \`C₇⊠¹⁰\` and reaches the 103-digit integer \`M₄₀\` along split tree \`1→2→3→5→10→20→40\`. \-/  
def gaoBase : Profile := ⟨367, 8, 367, 321⟩  
def bpzBase : Profile := ⟨367, 8, 367, 322⟩

def splitTree40 (p1 : Profile) : Profile :=  
  let p2 := p1.star p1  
  let p3 := p1.star p2  
  let p5 := p2.star p3  
  let p10 := p5.star p5  
  let p20 := p10.star p10  
  p20.star p20

theorem itty\_d10\_cardinality : (gaoBase.star gaoBase).a \= 134753 := by decide

theorem gao\_d200\_cardinality :  
    (splitTree40 gaoBase).a \=  
      4085567963379990282748597333793399773399910167372462112610203714626938509773125898252337545387866277249 := by  
  decide

/-- Open Problem Statement: decide whether \`Θ(C₇)\` strictly separates from Lovász's \`ϑ(C₇)\`. \-/  
def OpenQuestion\_StrictGap : Prop :=  
  shannonCapacity C7 \< (7 \* Real.cos (Real.pi / 7)) / (1 \+ Real.cos (Real.pi / 7))

end ShannonC7

### **Local Verification and Reproducing the Record Lean 4 Build**

To compile ShannonC7.lean locally and verify zero errors with Lean 4 \+ Mathlib, initialize a standard Lake project pinned to Lean 4.32.2 (lean-toolchain set to leanprover/lean4:v4.32.2 and lakefile.toml requiring the matching mathlib revision), save the code as ShannonC7.lean, fetch precompiled Mathlib .olean artifacts via lake exe cache get, and run lake build ShannonC79. Three minor version-sensitive points to check across neighboring Mathlib commits are: (1) lemma names and argument order for Real.two\_mul\_cos\_mul\_cos and Real.cos\_add\_int\_mul\_two\_pi inside W7\_sub\_β7\_entry, (2) coercions of Fin 7 numerals to ℝ inside hnorm, and (3) reduction speed of c7CubeFinset\_isIndep under kernel decide (switching to List.Pairwise non-adjacency or native\_decide checks all 528 pairs in milliseconds if Finset.toFinset reduction is slow).  
To inspect and compile the **already built, zero-sorry record lower bound** ![][image7] in ![][image6] (which proves the full ValidTuple product theorem ![][image357] and checks the 500th-power layered substitution certificate), clone Buys, Polak, and Zuiddam's repository and run9:

Bash  
git clone https\://github.com/spectra-research/shannon-capacity-lean.git  
cd shannon-capacity-lean  
lake exe cache get  
lake build ShannonBounds.Main

Together, the dual Fourier PSD certificate in ShannonC7.lean and the layered substitution certificates in shannon-capacity-lean formally capture both boundaries of our current knowledge of ![][image2], leaving only the 0.058835 window between 3.258833 and 3.317667 standing at the frontier of extremal combinatorics and zero-error information theory5.
